name: Retina Revealed
description: A 15-episode series covering the medical retina conditions optometrists encounter most — diabetic retinopathy, AMD, vein occlusions, and the OCT signs that drive referral decisions.

episodes.title: Diabetic Retinopathy: Classification, Screening Intervals, and the ETDRS Scale
episodes.description: The International Clinical DR scale (mild/moderate/severe NPDR, PDR), when to screen, and the findings that shorten the interval.

episodes.title: Diabetic Macular Edema: CSME Criteria and Anti-VEGF Referral
episodes.description: Recognising clinically significant macular edema, OCT features of DME, and when anti-VEGF therapy is indicated.

episodes.title: Dry Age-Related Macular Degeneration: AREDS2 and Progression Risk
episodes.description: Drusen types and their risk, the AREDS2 formulation evidence, and the Amsler grid and home OCT for monitoring conversion to wet AMD.

episodes.title: Wet AMD: Anti-VEGF Therapy, Loading Dose, and Treatment Intervals
episodes.description: The anti-VEGF agents (aflibercept, ranibizumab, bevacizumab, faricimab), the loading phase, and treat-and-extend vs pro re nata.

episodes.title: Central Serous Retinopathy: Presentation, OCT, and When It Resolves
episodes.description: The typical CSR patient (young male, stress, steroid use), the OCT appearance of serous detachment, and the watch-and-wait vs photodynamic therapy decision.

episodes.title: Branch and Central Retinal Vein Occlusions: Ischaemic vs Non-Ischaemic
episodes.description: Distinguishing ischaemic from non-ischaemic CRVO, the role of OCT-A and ERG, and when to treat macular oedema with anti-VEGF.

episodes.title: Retinal Artery Occlusions: The 90-Minute Window and Immediate Action
episodes.description: The central retinal artery occlusion emergency, ocular massage and anterior chamber paracentesis, and the systemic workup for embolic source.

episodes.title: Rhegmatogenous Retinal Detachment: The Four Walls and Urgent Referral
episodes.description: Recognising the classic symptoms (flashes, floaters, curtain), identifying a horseshoe tear on peripheral exam, and when it is a same-day emergency.

episodes.title: Macular Hole: Staging and the Vitrectomy Decision
episodes.description: Gass staging of macular holes (1-4), OCT confirmation, and when stage 2+ mandates surgical referral for vitrectomy with gas tamponade.

episodes.title: Epiretinal Membrane: When to Watch and When to Refer
episodes.description: The ERM OCT appearance, the cellophane maculopathy vs wrinkling distinction, and the visual acuity threshold for surgical referral.

episodes.title: OCT Interpretation for the Optometrist: Layers, Pathology, and Pitfalls
episodes.description: A systematic method for reading any macular OCT — identify the 10 layers, spot fluid (intraretinal, subretinal, sub-RPE), and avoid the common artifacts.

episodes.title: Fundus Autofluorescence: Reading RPE Health and Disease
episodes.description: What FAF shows (lipofuscin), hypo- vs hyper-autofluorescence patterns, and its role in monitoring geographic atrophy and Stargardt disease.

episodes.title: Peripheral Retinal Lesions: Lattice, Snailtrack, and Paving-Stone — Which to Refer
episodes.description: Which asymptomatic lesions warrant prophylactic laser, which are benign, and how to document and follow them.

episodes.title: Retinitis Pigmentosa: Presentation, Inheritance, and Low-Vision Care
episodes.description: The classic RP triad (bone-spicule pigmentation, disc waxy pallor, arteriolar attenuation), inheritance patterns, and the low-vision referral.

episodes.title: Coats Disease and Pediatric Retinal Vascular Anomalies
episodes.description: Recognising Coats disease (telangiectatic vessels, exudative detachment), the differential of leukocoria, and the urgency of paediatric retina referral.
